## Checklist

- [ ] Production behaviour changes have a requirement, a detailed design and a mock.
- [ ] Acceptance tests were written before the production code and now pass.
- [ ] Lint, formatting and the relevant tests pass locally.
- [ ] Visual baselines were updated only for intentional design changes.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for user-facing changes.
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/).
